The data were obtained in a similar fashion to the perpendicular case: Each relevant measurement was preceded and followed by a reference measurement taken with the artiﬁcial palate subject to no contact activation i.e., with 0 ‘‘on’’ electrodes . The preceding and following reference measurements were averaged and subtracted from the relevant measurement. This operation was repeated three times. The three resulting values were averaged among themselves following the procedure for the perpendicular condition.
